snippet.title: One More Plate! - Release Date Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

One More Plate is a quirky physics game with LocoRoco vibes where you serve food on anything except a real plate, from sausages to game controllers. You can play solo or in two-player co-op.
